name: Bot River
terroir: Cool maritime ward; lagoon and Walker Bay breezes; alluvial fast-draining soils ('Oil Spot' nickname); Groenlandberg cloud-trap moisture; long ripening, high natural acidity.
lede: Cool maritime ward; lagoon and Walker Bay breezes; alluvial fast-draining soils ('Oil Spot' nickname); Groenlandberg cloud-trap moisture; long ripening, high natural acidity.

routes.name: Bot River Wine Route (Bot River Vineyards)
routes.area: Bot River ward — Houw Hoek Pass to the lagoon, Walker Bay

routes.name: Green Mountain Eco Route
routes.area: Groenland mountain — Grabouw/Elgin, Bot River, Houw Hoek and Villiersdorp
routes.blurb: The world's first biodiversity wine route (Biodiversity & Wine Initiative), spanning Grabouw/Elgin, Bot River, Houw Hoek and Villiersdorp around the Groenland mountain.

tours.name: Percy Tours (trading as Hermanus Wine Tours)
tours.type: Private guided wine tours, luxury minibus

farms.name: Beaumont Family Wines
farms.history: Compagnes Drift: 1700s Dutch East India Company supply farm (fruit, dairy, wine, flour) holding the ward's oldest wine cellar; wine made in the 1940s, lapsed late 1960s.
farms.people: Beaumont — Raoul & Jayne (1974); Sebastian & Nici running since 2015; daughter Ariane.

farms.name: Gabriëlskloof Wine Estate
farms.history: The ward's destination hub 'on the koppie' beside the N2.
farms.people: Heyns family (Bernhard Heyns, founder-owner); winemaker Peter-Allan Finlayson (son-in-law) with wife Nicolene Heyns-Finlayson.

farms.name: Luddite Wines
farms.hours: Tastings weekdays 10:00-16:00; Saturdays & public holidays by appointment; office Mon-Thu 09:00-16:00, Fri 09:00-14:00.
farms.history: Founded 1999 with one aim — world-class Shiraz — while Niels was still Beaumont's winemaker (the ward's own talent-tree edge). Among the first to plant Shiraz in Bot River; first vintage 2000.
farms.people: Niels & Penny Verburg; daughter Alice in the cellar since 2017.

farms.name: Wildekrans Wine Estate

awards.sourceName: Veritas Awards — official 2025 complete results booklet
Veritas Awards — official 2025 complete results booklet

farms.history: 1,000ha estate among rhenosterbos, 35ha under vine; founded 1970s as mixed farming (wheat, olives, ostriches) before the cool terroir won.

farms.name: Barton Vineyards
farms.hours: Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, Sat 09:00-13:00; closed Sundays & public holidays; tastings free (reviews)
farms.history: ~200ha (500-acre) farm bordering the Kogelberg reserve, 33ha of vines on cool southerly slopes. Five Tuscan-style villas and a cottage, each with an eco wood-fired hot tub. Frost-free, Walker Bay breezes.

farms.name: Villion Wines
farms.hours: Small working family cellar — tastings by arrangement (often with Kobie or Elnette themselves)

awards.sourceName: Veritas Awards — official 2025 complete results booklet

farms.history: Kobie Viljoen is the 'Kobie' whose great work Peter-Allan Finlayson pledged to build on in the 2014 Gabriëlskloof handover — he left Gabriëlskloof that year (after Spier and others, 20+ years in) to found Villion.
farms.people: Kobie & Elnette Viljoen and their children.

farms.name: Genevieve MCC
signatureWines: Black Label Blanc de Blancs Brut (3yr lees)
Blue Label Blanc de Blancs Zero Dosage (4yr lees)
farms.history: SA's rare MCC-only house: vintage Cap Classique every year since 2008 (first release 2010). The sheets also place the MCC cellar in Paarl while the vineyards are Bot River.

farms.name: Arcangeli Family Vineyards
farms.history: Arcangeli is the former Feiteiras vineyards. Alessandro Arcangeli bought the 16ha farm beside the N2 in 2015; winemaker Krige Visser (of Mount Abora); 'Vini Autentici' minimal-intervention styling, Italian wine names.
farms.people: Arcangeli family — Alessandro 'Sandro' Arcangeli (first-generation from Rome)

farms.name: Rivendell Estate & Vineyards
farms.locality: south-facing slope of Mount Hebron (Kogelberg Biosphere), edge of the Bot River Lagoon, 5km from the Atlantic
farms.history: Austrian-south african estate: founded by Heimo and Maria, whose family's vineyard and distilling heritage traces to Austria — maiden vintages 2011 (Sauvignon Blanc, Shiraz), a dry Shiraz Rosé added since.
farms.people: Founded by Heimo & Maria (Austrian family — vineyard and distilling heritage in Austria); viticulturist Schalk du Toit.

farms.name: Paardenkloof Estate
farms.hours: Farm not open to public (working farm; wine-club members get exclusive vineyard visits).
farms.history: Boutique single-vineyard estate in a hidden valley; among the pioneers of reintroducing indigenous Nguni cattle to the Western Cape — regenerative-farming heritage central to the brand.

farms.name: Anysbos
farms.hours: Not open to the public (route guide; visitor facilities planned)
farms.history: Johan and Sue Heyns bought the land in 2007; olive oil, cheese and wine 'with patience and care'; first wines ~three years before the guide. Heyns surname matches Gabriëlskloof's owner Bernhard Heyns. Momento Wines is made here.

farms.name: Eerste Hoop Wines
farms.history: Mixed farm: olives, goat's-milk cheeses, grapes.

farms.name: Benguela Cove Lagoon Wine Estate
farms.hours: Open 7 days a week; tasting room, Moody Lagoon restaurant, brunch weekends/public holidays 09:30-11:30; Blackbeard's Diner Parkrun breakfast Saturdays 08:30; R43, Bot River Lagoon.

awards.sourceName: Veritas Awards — official 2025 complete results booklet

farms.history: 200ha lagoon-side estate, 70ha vines + 10ha olive groves, on the Bot River Lagoon at the gateway to Walker Bay.
farms.people: Penny Streeter OBE (British entrepreneur; owner since 2013)

farms.name: Crystallum
farms.people: Andrew and Peter-Allan Finlayson, brothers and the third generation of Finlayson winemakers; Peter-Allan is the winemaker, Andrew the viticulturist.

farms.name: Momento Wines
farms.locality: Anysbos Farm, Swartrivier Rd, Bot River (a host cellar, not a published tasting venue)

farms.name: Waterleliefontein
farms.locality: Waterleliefontein Farm, Van der Stel Pass, Bot River
